name: design-leadership-skills
description: Design Leadership Skills Collection: structured AI workflows for leading design. Domain-specific skills and chained workflows across 6 plugins — from managing people to building teams, setting strategy, influencing the org, running the operating cadence, and the craft of leadership itself.

plugins.name: people-management
plugins.description: Manage and grow people: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, performance reviews, career ladders, and difficult conversations.

plugins.name: team-building
plugins.description: Build the team: hiring loops, job specs, portfolio review, onboarding, team topology, and psychological safety.

plugins.name: design-strategy
plugins.description: Set direction: design vision, strategy documents, org-level design principles, investment cases, and portfolio prioritisation.

plugins.name: org-influence
plugins.description: Influence the organisation: executive narrative, influence mapping, design advocacy, securing resources, and managing up.

plugins.name: operating-cadence
plugins.description: Run the operating system: design reviews at scale, planning cadence, decision frameworks, delegation, and operating rhythm.

plugins.name: leadership-craft
plugins.description: Lead yourself: self-leadership, change leadership, conflict resolution, mentorship, and leadership ethics.
